title: The Mute Line
summary: On Day three, Wren learns what the cable she cut really did.

beats.text: Cal's whisper came out of my dead microphone.
"The cable you cut was the mute line. Now the mast carries every sound in the studio."
beats.speaker: cal

beats.text: Below, the crowd drifted uphill again, slowly, toward my breathing.
On the roof, a man clung to the black mast.
Cal, the engineer, a headset round his neck. He looked ashamed.
I held my breath on every stair.
Tilly texted: The radio on the teacher's desk turned itself on.
lines: The radio on the teacher's desk

beats.text: In the classroom, an old radio glowed. It breathed when I breathed.
"I built the mast to carry sound," Cal said. "I never meant it to carry you."
beats.speaker: cal

beats.text: "I can stop it, Wren. But someone has to stay up here." Then the mast began to sway.
